title: fnug config
description:
A fnug config file (`.fnug.yaml`, `.fnug.yml` or `.fnug.json`). The file is the root group,
plus file-level settings.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editors; ignored by fnug.

auto.description: Default auto-selection rules for every command.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to this file's directory.

env.description:
Environment variables for every command. `$VAR` and `${VAR}` expand to the process
environment; `$$` is a literal `$`.

fnug_version.description:
fnug version the config is written for. fnug warns if it needs a newer fnug or targets
an older release series.

id.description: Identifier for the root group. Defaults to the name; must not contain `/`.

name.description: Display name for the root group.

workspace.description: Discover and merge package configs from subdirectories.

ConfigAuto.description:
Rules for when a command is selected automatically. Each field is inherited from the
parent group unless set here.

check.description: Set to `false` to skip in `fnug check`, git hooks and MCP runs (default `true`).

git.description: Select when a file under `path` matching `regex` has uncommitted git changes.

path.description:
Path prefixes, relative to the working directory, that changed files must be under. They
don't have to exist. Defaults to the working directory; `[]` resets an inherited value to it.

regex.description:
Regular expressions matched against the changed file's path relative to the working
directory, with `/` separators (`src/main.rs`, or `../shared/lib.rs` outside it); a file
must match at least one. `[]` clears an inherited value, so any file matches.

watch.description: Select when a watched file under `path` matching `regex` changes.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the parent group's.

depends_on.description:
Commands that must finish successfully before this one runs, by id or by a name that is
unique among the command's siblings or in the config.

env.description:
Extra environment variables, added to the inherited ones. `$VAR` and `${VAR}` expand to
the inherited value or the process environment; `$$` is a literal `$`.

id.description:
Identifier used by `depends_on` and the MCP tools. Defaults to the name; must not
contain `/`.

scrollback.description: Number of scrollback lines kept for the command's terminal.

timeout.description:
In `fnug check` and MCP runs, kill the command once it has run this long. `0` means no
limit, overriding the parent group's value and `fnug check --timeout`. The TUI ignores
it.

ConfigCommandGroup.description: A group of commands and nested groups that share settings.

auto.description: Default auto-selection rules for everything in the group.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the parent group's.

env.description:
Environment variables for everything in the group, added to the inherited ones. `$VAR`
and `${VAR}` expand to the inherited value or the process environment; `$$` is a literal
`$`.

id.description: Identifier for the group. Defaults to the name; must not contain `/`.

timeout.description: Default `timeout` for everything in the group.

Duration.description: Whole seconds, or a duration such as `90s`, `5m` or `1h 30m`.

WorkspaceConfig.description: Workspace mode: `true` to discover package configs in subdirectories, or options.

WorkspaceOptions.description: Where to look for workspace package configs.

max_depth.description: How many directory levels the walk descends (default 5).

paths.description:
Glob patterns for package directories, relative to this config. Without it, fnug walks
the directory tree, skipping hidden and gitignored directories.
